name: champions-league
title: Champions League
description: Check UEFA Champions League standings, live matches, fixtures and results, and browse clubs, squads, players, stat leaders and every final since 1956.
author: kikks

commands.name: standings
commands.title: Standings
commands.subtitle: Champions League
commands.description: View the league phase table (or group tables for past seasons) with form, qualification zones and next fixtures.

commands.name: fixtures
commands.title: Fixtures
commands.subtitle: Champions League
commands.description: Follow live matches and browse upcoming Champions League fixtures.

commands.name: results
commands.title: Results
commands.subtitle: Champions League
commands.description: Look back over completed matches, working back through the season.

commands.name: clubs
commands.title: Clubs
commands.subtitle: Champions League
commands.description: Explore club profiles, squads, coaches, season stats and Champions League titles.

commands.name: players
commands.title: Players
commands.subtitle: Champions League
commands.description: Search registered players and view their profiles and Champions League statistics.

commands.name: stats
commands.title: Stats
commands.subtitle: Champions League
commands.description: See season leaderboards for goals, assists, clean sheets, top speed and more.

commands.name: champions
commands.title: Champions
commands.subtitle: Champions League
commands.description: Browse every European Cup and Champions League final, and the clubs with the most titles.

preferences.name: filter
preferences.title: Search Bar Filter
preferences.description: Choose how to filter Fixtures and Results from the search bar.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
